meta.name: ai-3d-generation
meta.description: Generate 3D models, rig characters and create PBR materials via inference.sh CLI. Models: Tripo 3.1, Meshy 7.1, Hunyuan 3D 3.1, Rodin Gen-2.5, HunyuanImage-to-3D 2, Rodin 3D Generator. Rigging: Tripo Auto Rig, Hunyuan 3D Auto Rigging, TokenRig. Materials: PATINA text-to-material, image-to-material, extract-material. Capabilities: text-to-3D, image-to-3D, multiview-to-3D, PBR textures up to 8K, quad and low-poly topology, part segmentation, auto rigging, preset animations, seamless tiling PBR maps. Use for: game assets, 3D printing, AR/VR models, product visualization, character rigging, texture libraries. Triggers: 3d model, text to 3d, image to 3d, 3d generation, 3d asset, glb, fbx, obj, stl, usdz, mesh generation, tripo, meshy, hunyuan 3d, rodin, hyper3d, auto rig, rigging, skinning, mixamo, pbr material, pbr texture, seamless texture, tileable texture, normal map, roughness map, patina
